verdict.rationale: Streaming server-rendered content is a fair performance axis for a web framework like Angular, so the story applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about server-side rendering, streaming, or hydration; it only has generic 'fast' claims, CLI commands, and community comments on client-side performance, none of which show this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream server-rendered content so pages get faster perceived loads before all client code arrives
